import re
DUMP = re.compile(r"^\*\*\* Dumping (?P<dump>\w+) Record Layout$")
ROW = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<offset>\S+) \|(?P<text>.*)$")
SIZE = re.compile(r"^\s*\| \[(?P<attrs>.*)\]$")
REC = re.compile(r"^(?P<kind>struct|union|class|enum) (?P<name>\S.*?)\s*$")
FIELD = re.compile(r"^(?P<type>\S(?:.*?\S)?)(?: (?P<name>\w+)| )?$")
DECL = re.compile(r"^Record: (?P<decl>\w+) (?P<address>0x[0-9a-f]+) <(?P<range>[^>]*)>(?: (?P<location>\S+:\d+(?::\d+)?))?(?: (?P<detail>\S.*))?$")
NODE = re.compile(r"^(?P<pre>[ |`]*)[|`]-(?P<rest>.*)$")
ANODE = re.compile(r"^(?P<node>\w+) (?P<address>0x[0-9a-f]+)(?: <(?P<range>[^>]*)>)?(?: (?P<location>\S+:\d+(?::\d+)?))?(?: (?P<detail>.*))?$")
NAMED = re.compile(r"^(?:(?P<name>\w+) )?'(?P<type>[^']*)'$")
VALUE = re.compile(r"^value: (?P<vtype>\w+) (?P<value>\S+)$")
KV = re.compile(r"^\s+(?P<key>\w+):(?P<value>.*)$")
BITF = re.compile(r"^\s*<CGBitFieldInfo (?P<attrs>.*)>$")
PAIR = re.compile(r"(\w+)[:=]([^,\s]+)")
RECNAME = re.compile(r"\b(?:struct|union|class|enum) \w+")


def uniform(rows):
    keys = []
    for r in rows:
        for k in r:
            if k not in keys:
                keys.append(k)
    return [{k: r.get(k, "") for k in keys} for r in rows]


def parse(lines):
    records, fields, decls, dfields, bits = [], [], [], [], []
    rl, fl, dl, nl, bl, skip = [], [], [], [], [], []
    record = ""
    names = {}
    field = None
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = DUMP.match(ln)
        if m:
            skip.append(i)
            record, field = "", None
            continue
        m = DECL.match(ln)
        if m:
            d = m.groupdict()
            r = RECNAME.search(d.get("detail") or "")
            record = r.group(0) if r else (d.get("detail") or "")
            row = {"record": record, "decl": d["decl"], "address": d["address"], "range": d["range"],
                   "location": d["location"] or "", "detail": d["detail"] or ""}
            decls.append(row)
            dl.append(i)
            field = None
            continue
        m = NODE.match(ln)
        if m:
            depth = len(m.group("pre")) // 2 + 1
            rest = m.group("rest")
            if depth == 1 or field is None:
                a = ANODE.match(rest)
                if not a:
                    continue
                d = a.groupdict()
                nm = NAMED.match(d.get("detail") or "")
                field = {"record": record, "node": d["node"], "address": d["address"], "range": d["range"] or "",
                         "location": d["location"] or "",
                         "name": (nm.group("name") or "") if nm else (d.get("detail") or ""),
                         "type": nm.group("type") if nm else "", "bitwidth": "", "children": ""}
                dfields.append(field)
            else:
                v = VALUE.match(rest)
                if v:
                    field["bitwidth"] = v.group("value")
                else:
                    kid = rest.split(" ", 1)[0].rstrip(":")
                    field["children"] = (field["children"] + "," + kid) if field["children"] else kid
            nl.append(i)
            continue
        m = BITF.match(ln)
        if m:
            row = {"record": record}
            for k, v in PAIR.findall(m.group("attrs")):
                row[k] = v
            bits.append(row)
            bl.append(i)
            continue
        if ln.startswith("Layout:") or ln.strip() in ("]>",) or ln.strip() == "BitFields:[":
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = KV.match(ln)
        if m and decls:
            decls[-1][m.group("key")] = m.group("value").strip()
            dl.append(i)
            continue
        m = SIZE.match(ln)
        if m:
            if records:
                for k, v in PAIR.findall(m.group("attrs")):
                    records[-1][k] = v
            rl.append(i)
            continue
        m = ROW.match(ln)
        if m:
            text = m.group("text")
            depth = (len(text) - len(text.lstrip(" ")) - 1) // 2
            body = text.strip(" ") if text.strip(" ") else ""
            if text.endswith(" ") and body:
                body = body + " "
            if depth == 0:
                r = REC.match(body)
                kind, name = (r.group("kind"), r.group("name")) if r else ("", body.strip())
                record = (kind + " " + name).strip()
                records.append({"kind": kind, "name": name, "offset": m.group("offset")})
                names = {0: record}
                rl.append(i)
                continue
            f = FIELD.match(body)
            ftype, fname = (f.group("type"), f.group("name") or "") if f else (body.strip(), "")
            names[depth] = fname
            fields.append({"record": record, "depth": depth, "parent": names.get(depth - 1, "") if depth > 1 else "",
                           "offset": m.group("offset"), "type": ftype, "name": fname})
            fl.append(i)
            continue
    blocks = [
        {"name": "records", "kind": "table", "lines": rl, "records": uniform(records)},
        {"name": "fields", "kind": "table", "lines": fl, "records": fields},
        {"name": "decls", "kind": "table", "lines": dl, "records": uniform(decls)},
        {"name": "decl_fields", "kind": "table", "lines": nl, "records": dfields},
        {"name": "bitfields", "kind": "table", "lines": bl, "records": uniform(bits)},
    ]
    return {"blocks": blocks, "skip": skip}
